title: Slovakian Cream Cakes
description: A traditional Slovakian dessert made with creamy whipped cream and a delicate cake.
instructions: Mix the Slovakian cream, sugar and whipping in a large bowl.
Add the bake mix and mix until combined.
Pour the mixture into a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
While the cake is baking, whip the cream until stiff peaks form.
Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool.
Top the cake with the whipped cream and serve.
